name: Image.Sendspin → On Image Display
description: An automation to perform when new artwork is ready to be shown. A common use is to refresh the display so the new artwork is drawn. The variable `lateness_ms` is available in [lambdas](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda). It reports how many milliseconds past the intended moment the artwork actually arrived, so a transition can be shortened by that much and still finish on schedule.
